entities.CO2: Carbon dioxide, a greenhouse gas contributing to global warming
entities.Methane: A potent greenhouse gas with 25x the warming potential of CO2
entities.Paris Agreement: 2015 international treaty to limit global warming to below 2°C
entities.1.5\u00b0C: Threshold identified to avoid the worst climate impacts
entities.Sea-level rise: Result of ice melt and ocean thermal expansion
entities.Glaciers: Losing mass globally due to warming
entities.El Ni\u00f1o: Periodic climate pattern that raises global temps
entities.Fossil fuels: Primary source of man-made greenhouse gases

facts: Human activities have caused approximately 1.1°C of global warming.
The past 9 years were the warmest on record.
Sea levels are rising about 3.3 mm/year.
Paris Agreement seeks to limit warming to 1.5–2°C.
Glaciers have lost over 7 trillion tons of ice since 2000.
Climate change drives more frequent extreme weather.
Methane makes up 20% of anthropogenic emissions.
